added.long_description:
Shielded is like wearing a Fitbit for your company's financial and supply chain health. 

We unify your internal ERP and data systems with external information sources, map how external prices and events flow through to your margins, and continuously track it all. 

That means opportunities and risks are flagged to you proactively, without the need to dig through and manually aggregate data.

long_description.before: Weave uses AI to understand engineering.
long_description.after:
Weave builds AI to understand engineering work from prompt to production. We show how much faster AI is making your team, how that impacts quality, and what it's costing. 

Weave then takes that data to route all of your tasks to the most cost efficient model without compromising speed or quality.

Weave is used by over 500+ orgs from startups to public companies like Robinhood, Posthog and Telnyx.

one_liner.after: AI to understand and then route engineering work

long_description.before:
Surveys ask people what they think they’ll do. Focus groups ask a handful of people to explain behavior they often don’t understand themselves.

Outrove simulates entire populations instead. We create AI agents that model how real audiences behave, letting companies, governments, and investors test decisions in minutes: what product to launch, what price to set, what campaign to run, what policy will work, or how a market will move.

The output is not another dashboard. It’s a prediction of what will happen, which segments will drive it, and what decision is most likely to win.

long_description.before:
Aside is an AI browser that completes real work across the websites you already use. It can sign in through your browser, work inside email, dashboards, internal tools, docs, and spreadsheets, and keep going when a task takes minutes or hours.

Unlike agents that depend on integrations, Aside uses the web the way you do. Browsing history becomes local memory, so it knows which tools and context matter. Its password manager lets agents autofill credentials without exposing secrets to the AI. Sensitive actions like payments, posts, and messages wait for your approval.

Aside is built as a fast daily browser plus a state-of-the-art browser agent. It ranks #1 on Online-Mind2Web, BU-Bench-V1, and Odysseys, and runs local-first with device-protected memory and data.

long_description.before:
Glue is an open source design editor for AI agents. It gives coding agents an infinite canvas to create new interfaces, iterate on existing ones, and turn those changes into production-ready code all in real time.

The rise of coding agents is collapsing EPD into one role: builders. This new paradigm means design and engineering can now converge to a single workflow. Builders no longer want static mockups in one tool, and implementation in another.

Glue is a collaborative workspace where builders and agents can create new components, iterate on existing interfaces, and implement as code. The same tight feedback loop that once made Figma powerful for designers is now built for builders and their armies of agents. Being open source allows us to penetrate workflows at zero cost and build trust quickly.

Right now there are no design tools with AI as the primary user. Existing tools bolt on copilots as an afterthought. Soon, every company will have AI agents building their interfaces. We are building the surface for this workflow.
long_description.after: Fractional buyer for hardware companies manufacturing experimental parts in critical industries

one_liner.before: The Interface Design Canvas for AI agents
one_liner.after: Fractional buyer for hardware companies in critical industries

long_description.before: Notyfi tracks anything you want, anywhere it happens. Tell us in plain English what matters, new lawsuits, layoffs, price drops, listings, RFPs, breaking news, and we watch the news, filings, databases, and the open web for it. You get notified instantly, hourly, daily, or weekly, by email, on a live dashboard, or directly into your agents and workflows through our API and MCP.
long_description.after: We are building a new way for AI to ground itself: a living database of real-time world facts. Our engine watches news, filings, databases, and the open web and compiles what it finds into structured facts. Each fact must compile, checked the way a mathematical proof is, so an agent citing it is citing something formally verified, not something plausible. Agents query it through our API and MCP to answer with what is true right now.

one_liner.before: Live alerts for anything happening in the world.
one_liner.after: The ground-truth layer for AI agents.
